Have no feeling of shame
then
for the witness of our Lord or for me
his prisoner: but undergo all things for the good news in the measure of the power of God;

这恩典是万古之先，
在基督耶稣里赐给我们的，
who saved us and called us with a holy calling
not according to our works

faith
